profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
• Experience of developing large-scale global web services handling billions of system executions daily.
• Experience of customer-facing roles that require troubleshooting urgent product issue with customers. 
• Experience of driving individual projects that require co-working with multiple teams.
• Domain Skills: OOP language (C#/Java), cloud technologies (Azure), NoSQL/SQL DB, restful web API, pipeline architecture, distributed system architecture, system analysis and agile development cycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
@Microsoft Dynamics CRM- (Background Runtime Async/Jobs Team) 

- Develop features and solve system issues for CRM Background Runtime Async/Jobs platform.
- Analyze platform’s performances, functionalities, alerting and monitoring issues to handle billions of system executions daily.
- Migrate/upgrade the platform from a legacy environment with the latest cloud technologies.
- Plan and drive individual projects (to bridge legacy and new code path) for the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
@Universal Store Membership - (MSEG Channels team) 

- Developed Microsoft Customer Chat Support backend core features (https://support.microsoft.com)
- Delivered web services that are highly resilient, scalable, and able to handle high volume millions of requests/messages(data) daily.
- Integrated with Azure data science text sentiment analysis service for analyzing customers' satisfaction in real time for every online chat support, which can help agents' supervisors know any ongoing chat support needs their attentions based on the real time customer’s satisfaction score.

positions.title: Software Engineer (On-Site at Microsoft)
Software QA Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote test cases for company’s mobile apps (iPhone, Android, and Blackberry).
- Wrote script for supporting server engineers to manage servers.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with engineering teams on developing new Customer Technical Support Tool.
- Redesigned the technical support process/tool and authored technical specifications, including envisaged usage cases, customer scenarios, and prioritized requirements lists.

honors.title: 2005 4C Digital Design Awards winner in Best Game Design Project
honors.description:
Team Project Name: A-Yao Music Game
- Over 100+ teams attended this campaign. 
- Developed an online mobile rhythm game and applied GPRS to relay signal between multiple players by building the socket/agent on the game server to receive user connection request and dealt with the networking connection between users’ phones (P2P).
honors.issuer: Issued by Industrial Development Bureau, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (Republic of China) · Dec 2005
